text: Fully managed durability, state persistence, retries, and flow control with no queues or workers to set up
quote: Inngest handles execution durability, state persistence, retries, and flow control for you. There are no queues to configure, no workers to deploy

text: Steps memoize results and retry independently, letting workflows resume from the last successful checkpoint
quote: Put side effects, API calls, sleeps, waits, and function invocations in steps so Inngest can memoize results, retry failures independently, and resume long-running work from the last successful checkpoint.

text: AI Overview dashboard surfaces usage, cost, and performance insights from captured AI call metadata
quote: We've added AI Overview, a dashboard that turns the OpenTelemetry-derived gen_ai.* metadata Inngest already captures from your AI calls into a live view of usage, cost, and performance across your environment.

text: Sessions automatically propagate from a run to any child runs it triggers
quote: Sessions now propagate to child runs. Any run triggered by another run (via event, invoke, or defer) inherits its parent's sessions.

text: MCP clients like Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor can connect to inspect and operate Inngest
quote: Connect Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or another MCP client to inspect and operate Inngest from your coding agent.

text: AgentKit framework for building AI agents, from single model calls to multi-agent tool-using systems
quote: AgentKit is a framework to build AI Agents, from single model inference calls to multi-agent systems that use tools.

text: REST API to programmatically interact with events, function runs, and environments
quote: The Inngest REST API lets you interact with events, function runs, environments, and more programmatically.

text: Official CLI to inspect runs, fetch traces, invoke functions, and give coding agents terminal access
quote: Inspect runs, fetch traces, invoke functions, and give coding agents access to your Inngest data from the terminal.

text: Self-hosting option for developers who don't want the hosted platform
quote: While the easiest way to get started with Inngest is using our hosted platform... we understand that developers may want to self-host for a variety of reasons.

text: Optional encryption middleware lets you bring your own key for added data protection
quote: For an added layer of encryption and control of your data, install encryption middleware and bring your own encryption key.

text: Create unique webhook consumer URLs for any third-party service
quote: Inngest enables you to create any number of unique URLs which act as webhook consumers. You can create a webhook for each third party service that you use

text: Step concurrency limits can be scoped per key, e.g. per user id
quote: Step concurrency can be optionally configured using "keys" which applies the limit to each unique value of the key (ex. user id).

text: Hard rate limiting skips function runs that exceed a configured threshold within a time window
quote: Rate limiting is a hard limit on how many function runs can start within a time period. Events that exceed the rate limit are skipped and do not trigger functions to start.

text: Jest-compatible testing API mocks function state, steps, and inputs across major test frameworks
quote: This allows you to mock function state, step tooling, and inputs with a Jest-compatible API supporting all major testing frameworks, runtimes, and libraries

text: Functions and steps automatically retry up to 4 times by default until they succeed
quote: By default, in addition to the initial attempt, Inngest will retry a function or a step up to 4 times until it succeeds.

text: Durable Endpoints turn API logic into fault-tolerant endpoints by wrapping it in durable steps
quote: Durable Endpoints let you build or transform your API into fault-tolerant endpoints simply by wrapping your critical logic into durable steps.

text: Cron schedules support timezones for scheduling work at the right local time
quote: Inngest's cron schedules also support timezones, allowing you to schedule work in whatever timezone you need work to run in.

text: step.waitForEvent() pauses a run until a matching event arrives or a timeout elapses
quote: Use step.waitForEvent() to wait for a particular event to be received before continuing. It returns a Promise that is resolved with the received event or null if the event is not received within the timeout.

text: Deploy new function code without explicit version markers or manual migration logic
quote: Inngest enables developers to deploy changes to functions without explicit version markers or complex migration logic.

text: Automatic capture of metrics, traces, event logs, and per-step timing for every run
quote: Inngest captures execution data for every function run. You get metrics, traces, event logs, and per-step timing without instrumenting your code.

text: Every agent step and tool call is checkpointed so a crashed run resumes at its last completed step, not from scratch
quote: Every step, every tool call, every decision the agent makes is checkpointed as it happens. If the process dies at step 7 of 12, the agent picks up at step 7 — not step 1.

text: step.ai.wrap() wraps OpenAI, Anthropic, and Vercel AI SDK calls as durable steps with prompt/token observability
quote: step.ai.wrap() wraps other AI SDKs (OpenAI, Anthropic, and Vercel AI SDK) as a step, augmenting the observability of your Inngest Functions with information such as prompts and tokens used.

text: Guide for building ReAct-style agent loops where each reason/act/observe iteration is a durable, retriable step
quote: This guide walks you through building a ReAct-style agent loop (Reason → Act → Observe → Repeat) where each iteration is a durable, retriable step.

text: Write workflow functions in TypeScript, Python, or Go with built-in steps, queueing, scaling, and observability handled for you
quote: Write functions in TypeScript, Python or Go to power background and scheduled jobs, with steps built in. We handle the backend infra, queueing, scaling, concurrency, throttling, rate limiting, and observability for you.

text: Deploy functions to your own infrastructure and sync them with the managed platform or a self-hosted server
quote: Deploy your functions to your own infrastructure. Sync your application's functions with the Inngest Platform or a self-hosted Inngest server.
